[[Snap Flamekrak]] }} [[Stone Summit Emblem]]s are trophies [[drop]]ped by [[Stone Summit]] dwarves in Eye of the North. ==Acquisition== * [[Eye of the North]] ** [[Far Shiverpeaks]] and [[Depths of Tyria]] *** [[Stone Summit]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Stone Summit Emblem#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== {{section-stub}} One of the fastest and most efficient ways to farm Stone Summit Emblems is by repeating the quest [[Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!]]. Foes give a lot of experience and drop a few of Stone Summit Emblems per run (1-3), which takes 5-8 minutes. ==Collectors== {{:Marduc Snakeslayer/Collector}} {{:Snap Flamekrak/Collector}} ==Notes== * This item shares its icon with the [[Prophecies]] [[Stone Summit Badge]]s that can be found on the Stone Summit in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks|Northern]] and [[Southern Shiverpeaks|Southern]] [[Shiverpeaks]] as well as, on occasion, the Far Shiverpeaks.
